versions.content: On reception of request for DM19 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according Table column “PGN (Hexadecimal)”) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall trigger the operation GetCalibrationVerificationNumber of port prototype J1939Dcm_CalibrationInformation to collect the CVN (see also chapter 8.7.3.1).
